title: Knowledge bases
subtitle: Vector stores for retrieval-augmented generation. API keys search them with file_search and /v1/vector_stores. Every knowledge base belongs to exactly one company and optionally one project, and is never visible to another company or project.
empty: Create a knowledge base, upload documents, and let the company's API keys search them with file_search.
readOnly: You can view knowledge bases and their files. Changing them needs the tenancy:manage permission.
loadFailed: Knowledge bases could not be loaded. Reload the page.
noMatches: No knowledge base matches the filters.
